_comment: What the app veils as a story spoiler, by dataset and id.
This is a judgement file, not a derivation — 'late-game' is not a fact any
source states, so a human decides. The build stamps `spoiler: true` on the
listed records (centrally, in build/data.ts; no builder knows about this
file), the display index carries the flag, and the app veils names and
pages behind an explicit 'show me' acknowledgement. Nothing is ever
filtered out: the veil withholds a name, never a row.
SCOPE. Endgame reveals only — the project owner's decision, 2026-08-08.
The true-identity reveals (Caldarus, Seridia) and the final story arc are
veiled; early and mid content that every player meets in normal play (the
Deep Woods, the water and earth tablets, the first seals) is not. Widen or
narrow freely: an id added here is veiled on the next build, and the
validate step fails on any id that does not exist in its dataset, so a
ALIASES. A name that is itself the reveal. It moves from the record's
shown only to someone who typed it — they already know). The alias must
